MAR-18-2010 IN DEPT. 220, AFTER DISCUSSING OFF THE RECORD DATES AND OBLIGATIONS, THE COURT ADOPTS THE TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: PLTF'S MOTION FOR PREFERENCE IS GRANTED PURSUANT TO CCP 36 (D). TRIAL DATE SET ON 4/19/10 @ 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 220. NOTICE WAIVED. THE COURT ORDERED ALL COUNSEL TO WORK TOGETHER IN GOOD FAITH OTHERWISE CONTACT JUDGE KAHN BY PHONE OR EMAIL. NO DISCOVERY MOTIONS WITHOUT PERMISSION FROM THE COURT. DEEMED SERVED TODAY WITHOUT NEED FOR ANY DOCUMENTATION ARE COMPREHENSIVE CONTENTION INTERROGATORIES ON PLTF AS TO EACH OF THE 4 CLAIMS ALLEGED IN COMPLAINT. PLAINTIFF TO STATE ALL FACTS SUPPORTING EACH OF THEIR CLAIMS AS TO EACH DEFT AND SEPARATED OUT BY DEFT, STATE THE NAMES AND ALL CONTACT INFORMATION OF PERSON WHO HAVE KNOWLEDGE OF FACTS AND SPECIFICATIONS OF FACTS, ID SPECIFICITY OF ALL DOCUMENTS REFERRING TO THESE FACTS. THIS DISCOVERY & REQUEST FOR ADMISSIONS ON BEHALF OF EACH DEFT ASKING THE PLTF TO ADMIT MR. SHAFFER WAS NOT EXPOSED AS TO THAT DEFT NEEDS TO RESPOND WITHOUT ANY OBJECTION OTHER THAN WORK PRODUCTS BY 3/29/10. PLTF TO GIVE PREVIEW OF DISCOVERY RESPONSES, LIST OF CO-WORKERS WITH ALL CONTACT INFORMATION, AND ANY BANKRUPTCY TRUST INFORMATION TO DEFTS BY NOON ON 3/23/10. PLTF TO SERVE DISCOVERY ON 3/22/10. ANY MOTIONS FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT TO BE HEARD ON 4/12/10 @ 9:30 AM IN DEPT. 220. MOTIONS TO BE EFILED/ESERVED BY 4/2/10, OPPOSITION BY 4/7/10, REPLY BY 4/9/10, AND COURTESY COPIES TO DEPT. 220 ON THE SAME DAY OF EFILING. PLTF TO PROVIDE RECORDS TO DEFT AT THE EARLIEST POSSIBLE DATES, AND DEFT TO RESPOND BY 4/2/10. ISSUES TO BE HEARD AT THE CMC ON 3/25/10 @ 2:30 PM IN DEPT. 220. PLTF MUST PROVIDE ECONOMIC EXPERT TESTIMONY ON ECONOMIC DAMAGES BY 4/2/10. A MSC IS SET ON 4/13/10 AT 9:00 AM IN ROOM 603. PLTF TO SUBMIT SETTLEMENT DEMANDS BY 1 PM ON 4/12/10. PARE DOWN EXPERT DISCLOSURES FOR PLTF DUE BY 4/23/10 AND DEFTS DUE BY 4/26/10. EXPERT DEPOSITION TO BEGIN ON 4/13/10 UNTIL COMPLETED. PLTF TO PREPARE ORDER. JUDGE: HAROLD KAHN
